title: CR-BRK-015 — Wages ON, App Settings OFF — sub-setting isolation
preconds: Settings \u2713 | Wages \u2713 | App Settings \u2717 | (other subs \u2717) | WO V \u2713 | View Mode: Full (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Open Administration; confirm only Wages visible; confirm Roles/Staff hidden.
expected:
Administration accessible; only the Wages section visible and wage rates viewable/manageable. App Settings sections (org config, Roles & Permissions, Staff) hidden.

Risk / Rationale: Wages page requires App Settings and breaks, or App Settings content leaks alongside Wages.
Spec Ref: §3 Settings sub-settings
